cheap_test.superabundance_target: active genus-one ray requires large speciality rather than ordinary expected-codimension behavior

W26.reason: The readily available T-smoothness theorems do not apply to the MB104 divisor lattice. Direct import is invalid.
W26.remaining_open: A cuboid-specific extension of Bogomolov/Keilen regularity to the high-rank lattice could directly contradict the retained superabundance and is therefore a meaningful soft-park.

W27.reason: The classical semiregularity map H1(N)->H2(O_S) cannot be injective when h1(N)=112l>7. Thus the simple semiregularity-unobstructedness route is unavailable; large obstruction space is compatible with existence.
W27.remaining_open: A reduced obstruction theory, cosection, or special normal-complex calculation could still annihilate the relevant obstruction subspace.

cheap_test.connectedness_required_shape: -(K_S+B) nef and big (or equivalent log-Fano positivity) for the standard non-klt connectedness mechanism
cheap_test.actual_sign: K_S+B is positive in the H direction for effective B built from the carrier

W28.reason: The standard connectedness/Nadel architecture runs with the wrong sign on this general-type surface. It cannot force the 14 packet centers to connect.
W28.remaining_open: Multiplier ideals used for vanishing/interpolation rather than log-Fano connectedness remain possible.

W29.reason: The exact degree split is perfectly compatible with generic nefness/semipositivity of the cotangent bundle; no negative quotient is forced.
W29.remaining_open: A strong stability theorem for Omega_S whose restriction applies to this special carrier could prohibit a degree-zero quotient, but generic restriction theorems do not automatically apply to the special MB104 curve.

W30.route: Wahl/Gaussian-map dimension obstruction for the ambient g^6_d
W30.reason: There is no dimension overload: the Gaussian map from the seven ambient sections can occupy only a tiny subspace of the available target. Failure of surjectivity is expected and cannot exclude the embedding/projection.
W30.remaining_open: A specific Gaussian-map identity forced by a canonical complete-intersection surface, rather than a dimension count, could still be restrictive.

round_summary.next_action: Continue broad search only if new mechanisms remain semantically distinct. Keep W26 as a higher-value soft park because a valid T-smoothness theorem would directly attack the retained superabundance.
